messages:
Priya (Product): FYI ACME wants a short pilot (1 week) that MUST feel interactive — they said <120ms p95 and customer-managed KMS. We need to agree on what we can promise for pilot.
Liam (Eng - Runtime): <120ms p95 is challenging at 2k ctx. With current model+quant + KV caching we hit ~140ms p95 on our standard nodes. Quick levers: reduce ctx to 1k, reserve higher-tier HW (H100), or accept higher p95 and compensate in UX.
Devon (Infra): Reserved H100 pool is doable but lead time ~7 business days and costs jump ~2.5x vs shared A100s. We can spin a small dedicated pool (2 nodes) faster if we pre-approve billing.
Kai (Security): Full HSM/KMS integration needs vendor paperwork + attestation — expect 3+ weeks. For pilot we can offer a KMS proxy pattern (customer-managed key material routed through a proxy) if legal signs off on a Risk Acceptance Form.
Anika (Product): Proposal: run a two-track pilot so ACME can try the product quickly while we complete security onboarding:
- Fast-track: ctx=1k, dedicated mid-tier nodes, KMS-proxy (mock HSM), target ~110-120ms p95
- Secure-track: full KMS/HSM + ctx=2k once security + infra prep complete
Liam (Eng - Runtime): I'll bench a proto: ctx=1k, quant-lite, KV prefix caching, QoS routing. Expect perf numbers and perf vs cost matrix.
Devon (Infra): I'll produce cost + ETA for both fast and secure tracks and note what requires reserved capacity.
Kai (Security): I'll draft a 1-page RAF and list the minimal audit hooks we need (request IDs, KMS access logs, key rotation proof).
Priya (Product): Action items & due dates:
- Liam: perf matrix + experiment notes (EOD Mon)
- Devon: cost + capacity plan for both tracks (EOD Tue)
- Kai: RAF draft + required signoffs (EOD Tue)
- Priya: confirm ACME will accept ctx=1k fast-track or not (EOD Wed)
ops-bot: Please create a pilot ticket and tag @Priya @Liam @Devon @Kai with due dates.
ops-bot: Ticket created: PL-10234, channel #pilot-acme.
Liam (Eng - Runtime): I'll attach kernel-level traces and a fallback routing policy (route to lower-latency smaller-ctx model) in the ticket.
Devon (Infra): If ACME refuses proxy/mock KMS we need an explicit sign-off to proceed with dedicated infra — call that out in legal.
Anika (Product): Let's reconvene Fri 10:00 PT. Post blockers to PL-10234 before then. :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): ack
Liam (Eng - Runtime): ack
Kai (Security): ack
